title: A motivic derived Fourier transform
summary: We construct a theory of Fourier transform for rational étale motives on derived vector bundles over derived Artin stacks over a field of positive characteristic, defined as the integral transform with kernel the Artin-Schreier motive. The basic properties are established: involutivity, base change, functoriality, duality, monodromicity, constructibility, and compatibilities with various natural transformations.
